A regional food bank moves donated produce from four collection points to
eleven neighbourhood pantries using two refrigerated vans and a rotating pool
of volunteer drivers. Routing is decided the night before by one coordinator
working from a spreadsheet, and spoilage runs high on the longest legs.

Plan a redesign of the daily dispatch process. Cover how routes are decided,
how volunteer availability is collected and confirmed, what the coordinator
does when a driver cancels an hour before pickup, how cold-chain time is kept
inside safe limits, what is measured to show spoilage actually fell, and a
phased rollout that starts with a single collection point.

Produce a plan of roughly 600 words.
